# E0713: a disjunction in a schema has no discriminant for a Cap'n Proto union

A disjunction compiles to a Cap'n Proto union, and the engine must decide from
the value alone which member holds it. That needs alternatives of distinct
kinds, all constants, or structs with a tag field holding a distinct constant
in each. Here both alternatives are integers, so no value says which one it
is.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				size: int8 | int16
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0713]: size in schema 0.0 has no discriminant for a Cap'n Proto union
 --> lineage.cue:6:5
  |
6 |                 size: int8 | int16
  |                 ^^^^
  |
  = note: size in schema 0.0 is int8 | int16, with several alternatives of kind int that are not all constants; no discriminant can be derived from a value (Cap'n Proto rule disjunction-undiscriminated)
  = help: give struct alternatives a tag field with a distinct constant in each, make the alternatives of distinct kinds, or make them all constants
```
